description: This file contains assembly implementations of string manipulation functions such as strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strchr, strcmp, strncmp, strlen, memset, memmove, memcpy, backwards_memcpy, memchr, memcmp, and cache flushing routines for the PowerPC architecture, packaged as ELF32 code.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to a specified number of characters from source to destination, ensuring null-termination.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates source string to the end of destination string.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares up to a specified number of characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specified byte.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory areas, handling overlapping regions safely.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies a block of memory from source to destination.

methods.name: backwards_memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory backwards, useful for overlapping regions.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Locates a character in a block of memory.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes data cache and invalidates instruction cache for a specified memory range.
